english: Swords cut orcs.
The elf finds (or discovers) a city.
I am shining.
The king is watching birds.
The dwarves are running.
Men have houses.
I watch stars.
The birds sleep.
I have a bird.
The stars shine.
An orc cuts the forest.
The captain is sleeping.
Birds are eating.
I am watching the house.
The men find (or discover) the elves.
Elves are going.
He/she is running.
You are watching my house.
I cut you.
Your swords are shining.
You are eating it.
His king is going.
I find the forest.
The elf watches them.
You have my sword.
The captain finds your forests.
The elf watches his/her city.
I am going.
The dwarf finds me.
He/she is sleeping.

quenya: Orko mátas or Orko máta se.
english: An orc is eating him/her.
His kings run.

quenya: I turkë atani kirir i taurë sí.
english: The strong men cut the forest now.
An orc [is] wet.
A blue bird is sleeping.

quenya: I aran oialë tirë i osto.
english: The king forever watches the city.
I cut the swift orc.
I cut swift[ly] the orc.

quenya: I eldar tírar i alkarin elen.
english: The elves are watching the glorious star.
You are a tall dwarf.
Birds go far.
The dead orcs are blue.
The captain sleeps well.
The well loved king is eating.
The man is running from the orcs.
Birds are sleeping in the forest.
Dwarves [are] under the hills.
The stars shine in the heavens.
The captain of men [is] without a sword.
The king now goes to his city.
The orc [is] strong like iron.

quenya: I atani menir et i ostollo.
english: The men go out from the city.
The dwarf has a sword of iron.
The sky [is] above the hills.

quenya: Mátan mindoninyassë or Mátan mi mindoninya.
english: I am eating in my tower.

quenya: Qualini eldar lorir oialë i ambossen.
english: Dead elves sleep forever in the hills.

quenya: I atan ar i nauko samir makili.
english: The man and the dwarf have swords.

quenya: Makili i kirir orkor silir luini.
english: Swords that cut orcs shine blue[ly].
He/she has a sword from which orcs run.

quenya: Tíran i hesto orkoron yenna i orkor menir.
english: I am watching the captain of orcs to whom the orcs go.

quenya: Eldar lorir i (“the”) tauressë i (“that”) orkor kirir.
english: Elves sleep in the forest that orcs cut.

quenya: Atani tuvir i taurë yassë i eldar lorir.
english: Men find the forest where [= in which] the elves sleep.

quenya: Eldar nórar i orkollon i kírar i taurë.
english: Elves are running from the orcs who are cutting the forest.

quenya: Atani ar naukor ménar i taurenna yallo i eldar norir.
english: Men and dwarves are going to the forest from which the elves run.
The cave lies (is situated) under a mountain.
An elf is resting/tarrying in the village.

quenya: Tië tulyanë i atan i nórenna.
english: A road led the man to the country.
The way goes forever.
The dwarves departed from the cave.
The captain stood up beside his/her wagon.

quenya: I tië mennë et i nandollo.
english: The road went out from the valley.
Now I am arriving at the tower.
You are standing under the roof.

quenya: I sírë kelu nu i yanta.
english: The river flows under the bridge.
The man went to the city.
He/she is departing from the forest.

quenya: I orkor marir nu i oron.
english: The orcs dwell under the mountain.
The captain sent for an elf.
The river lies beside your country.
A street leads me from the tower.
The tomb sits on a hill.

quenya: Nauko hárua köalyassë or mi köalya.
english: A dwarf is sitting down in your house.
The tower is standing by a lake.
The king traveled to Middle-earth.
My friend [is] hasty.
The small dwarf [is] a woman.
The mountains [are] steep.
Your boy [is] a short person.
The girls were good friends.
I am slow now.
You will be dead.

quenya: I raika sírë i kelu ar’ i osto núra ná.
english: The crooked river that flows by the city is deep.

quenya: I aiwi i atani fárëar lintë nár.
english: The birds that men are hunting are swift.
It is quiet.
His/her child is small.
The deep valley is narrow.
The men [males] are friends.
Straight rivers are wide.
The tall towers were crooked.
I will be burly.
The halflings will be fat.
It is bad.

quenya: I perian i nóra i tauressë linta ná.
english: The halfling who is running in the forest is swift.

quenya: I eldar i tírar i aran quildë nár.
english: The elves who are watching the king are quiet.
The women are in the city [semi-permanently].
The house is on the hill.

quenya: I tië latë nu i yanta.
english: The road is under the bridge.

quenya: I elda serë i köassë. Alternately harë.
english: The elf is in the house [temporarily].
The towers are in the forest.

quenya: I kirya luntë et i ëarello ar mí londenna.
english: The ship sailed out of the sea and in to the harbour.

quenya: I nér i hára i falassessë kiryamo ná.
english: The man [male] that is sitting on the shore is a sailor.

quenya: I tyulma tára halla i luntessë.
english: The mast is standing tall on the boat.

quenya: Kiryar lutir ëaressë mal aiwi vilir vilyassë.
english: Ships sail on [the] sea but birds fly in [the] sky.
The moon shone on the hill.

quenya: Lauka hwesta i ostossë mára ná.
english: A warm breeze in the city is good.

quenya: Anar kála ar i aiwi vílar vilyassë.
english: The sun is shining and the birds are flying in the sky.
Dark clouds float in the sky.

quenya: Falma i ailinessë nitya ná mal falma i ëaressë höa ná.
english: A wave on the lake is small, but a wave on the sea is large.
The wind is strong now.

quenya: Atan hya nauko tirë kemen mal elda tirë menel.
english: A man or a dwarf watches the earth but an elf watches the sky.

quenya: I nissi túler i tollenna yassë i eldar marir.
english: The women came to the island where (= on which) the elves live.

quenya: Lëa melë Oren ar Oren melë Lëa.
english: Lëa loves Oren and Oren loves Lëa.

quenya: Lëa ar Oren vestaner i tauressë.
english: Lëa and Oren married in the forest.

quenya: Nosserya túlë i veryanwenna, mal nossë Oreno vánë i taurello.
english: Her family came to the wedding, but Oren’s family left the forest.
More literally: ... the family of Oren departed from the forest.
Her father stood beside Lëa.
Lëa’s mother (or the mother of Lëa) watched from the hill.
Her [casual] friend Cissë was there also.

quenya: Lëa ar Oren ontaner yondo Miro.
english: Lëa and Oren conceived [begat] a son Miro.
Lëa loved the son of her husband.
Then Lëa gave birth to a daughter Tilë.
Tilë loves her brother Miro.

quenya: Miro tirë nésarya Tilë yá nostaryar menir i ostonna.
english: Miro watches his sister Tilë when his parents go to the city.
My name [is] Lëa.

quenya: Elerondo nyarnë i lúmequenta eldaron andanéya Arakornon.
english: Elrond told the history of Elves long ago to Aragorn.
The girl is writing letters with a pen.
The man [human] is speaking to the man [male].
I called my daughter with my voice.
I am naming my son Miro.
You wrote a book with paper.

quenya: I nís henta parmar i aranen.
english: The woman reads books to the king.
The girl spoke a word to her mother.

quenya: I nauko antanë tekil i seldon.
english: The dwarf gave a pen to the boy.
You (plural) are dancing on the hills.
You (familiar) recited your poem and it was good.
Your (polite) flute sings to me.
Music calls our spirits.

quenya: Túvelmë i orko ar tíralmes sí.
english: We (but not you) found the orc and we (but not you) are watching him/her now.

quenya: Lírelvar lairi eldaron nár, ar nanta márë.
english: Our (including you) songs are poems of elves, and they (inanimate) are good.

quenya: Tekilya nánë linta ar liltanes i hyalinessë.
english: His pen was swift and it danced on the paper.
Their son is singing gaily to us (including you).
You (familiar) have a blue bell.
Your (plural) drums are calling them.
We (but not you) sang for our (including you) king.
The singer had my harp.
Hail! Are you writing a book?
Yes. It will be good.
Oh, I want to read it.

quenya: Á anta i tekil nin, mekin.
english: Give the pen to me, please.
I am doing it now.
Thank you. (Go) to happiness.

quenya: Máriessë. Mára ná i túlel, tar.
english: (Stay) in happiness. It is good that you came, sir.

quenya: Ná, hesto. Kenin i karnel i makil.
english: Yes, captain. I see that you made the sword.
Behold! I made it for you, my king.
It pleases me well.
I am giving it to you, my king.
I want to hunt orcs with it. Farewell!

quenya: Á tulë i taurenna lúmessë andúnëo.
english: Come to the forest at the hour of sunset.
I will see my mother tomorrow.
I want to rest at night.
The moon will rise up in the east.
May the Sun shine on you (familiar) today.

quenya: Yá kenin Valinorenna, formen forya ar hyarmen hyarya.
english: When I look towards Valinor, north [is] right and south [is] left.
May the dawn be warm for you (plural).

quenya: I oron haiya mal kenuvalves i arinessë.
english: The mountain is far away but we (including you) will see it in the morning.
Stay a day (24 hours) in the cave.
The Moon will go down in the west.
The Sun shines in the day.
I came to the tower yesterday.
The man found the city.
The moon is shining now above a road.
The halfling will eat a bird tomorrow.

quenya: I nís merë marë mi taurë.
english: The woman wants to live in a forest.

quenya: I nauko fárëa i orkor nu i oron.
english: The dwarf is hunting the orcs under the mountain.
Birds fly under the heavens/sky.

quenya: Ninqui axor naukoron kaitar nu i oron.
english: [The] white bones of dwarves lie under the mountain.

quenya: Luini aiwi vílar or i andë tiër.
english: Blue birds are flying above the long roads.
The man’s blood [is] red.
Lamps are shining golden[ly] in the city.
I see [the] brown fingers of his/her hand.
[The] black hearts of orcs rest in their chest.

quenya: I serkë-quilië mindoni tarir i ambossen.
english: The blood-coloured towers stand on the hills.
Children have little toes.
Strong arms make powerful men.

quenya: I hesto kirnë i orquion telqui or telqui i orquion.
english: The captain cut the orcs’ legs.
Pale white clouds fly in the sky.

quenya: I sindë eldar marir laikë tauressen.
english: The grey elves dwell in green forests.
The man [male] is cooking meat.

quenya: I seldo antanë yávi i netten.
english: The boy gave fruits to the girl.
My mother is baking bread now.
Your father bit the apple.
Elves make mead with honey.
Vegetables and fruits are good food.
The husband poured wine for his wife.
Give [to] me a cup of water.

quenya: Matuvalvë mat ó i periandi síra.
english: We [and you] will eat a meal [together] with the halflings today.
I want a drink of wine now.
You licked my hand with [by means of] your tongue.
The woman ate an orange.
A woman sowed seeds in her field.
Some plants grew swift[ly] there.
The woman seemed happy in her field.
Food abounded to the woman (= the woman had lots of food).
The woman baked bread.
A girl received bread from the woman.

quenya: Seldoli rapper i massa i nettello.
english: Some boys snatched the bread from the girl.
The girl kicked the leg of a boy.

quenya: I seldor hlasser i nettë yalë i hesto.
english: The boys heard the girl call the captain.

quenya: Nirnentë i nettë öa ar nornentë i hestollo.
english: They pushed the girl away and they ran from the captain.

quenya: I hesto kensë i osto i seldoin.
english: The captain searched the city for the boys.
The roof covered the children.
Some lights are shining in the city.
[It] will rain tomorrow.
The forest [is] warm today.
In the cave [it] is dark.
[It] is snowing and the snow [is] cold.
[It] was cold yesterday.
Fire [is] hot.
Water [is] wet.
Ice [is] cold.
Light [kindle] a lamp, please.
The air is warm in the house.
Plants grow in the earth.
My (pair of) eyes are watching the two orcs.

quenya: I nauko fanga ninquë yo sinda.
english: The dwarf’s beard [is] both white and grey.

quenya: Súlerya autëa peu i atano lenka.
english: His/her breath is leaving the man’s [human’s] lips slow[ly].
The pair of children have golden hair.

quenya: I elda nustanë i nísima hwesta.
english: The elf smelled the fragrant breeze.
I hear a noise in the forest.

quenya: Ma hlarulya hlaret i arano quettar?
english: Do your ears hear the king’s words?
The pair of birds sang in the tree.
His tongue tasted a bitter vegetable.

quenya: Aiwi vilir or nór yo ëar.
english: Birds fly above both land and sea.

quenya: I perian mantë lissë orva ar’ i aldu.
english: The halfling ate a sweet apple beside the pair of trees.
I smell a stinking orc.
The halfling is growing food for his/her people.
The girl cut grass for her father.
The seeds sprouted in [by means of] the heat of the Sun.

quenya: I nís tiruva hínali i naukoin.
english: The woman will watch (some) children for the dwarves.
The captain spoke to the king.
Flowers (are) good to me = I like flowers.
The dwarves dig gold for their king.
Flowers bloom in daytime.
A garden [is] good for plants.

quenya: I eldar antaner makilli i atanin.
english: The elves gave some swords to the men.
A tree will grow in the field.

quenya: I nér maxanë mat i perianden.
english: The man [male] cooked a meal for the halfling.
I have jumped into the river.
The ship has floated in the harbour.
The king has raised his sword.
The river has flowed from the mountain.
The dwarf has followed the man.
The house has collapsed in the night.
The elf has run to the forest.
The boy has pushed the girl.
The man has walked to the city.
He/she has fallen in the garden.
The man [male] has risen in the morning.
The captain has struck the bell.
The dwarf is not tall.
I was not brave.

quenya: I atani uir laituva i aran.
english: The men will not praise the king.
Do not go to the city today.
I won’t! I will not go to the city.

quenya: I aran váquentë i voronda hesto auta.
english: The king forbade the loyal captain to leave.
The orc is not beautiful.

quenya: Áva verya i raxë i rottossë.
english: Do not dare the danger in the cave.
I won’t! I will not do an evil thing.
The king was not good [moral].
The boy will become admirable.

quenya: I seldo aptanë menë i ostonna.
english: The boy refused to go to the city.
War came to the land.

quenya: I hesto tirnë i kottor i ambollo.
english: The captain watched the enemies from the hill.
The commanders of the orcs quarrelled.

quenya: I hesto ortanë ehtirya ar yallë i ohtari.
english: The captain raised his/her spear and called the warriors.

quenya: I ohtari mahtaner i orkor makilínen (or orqui).
english: The warriors fought the orcs with swords.
They protected the captain with shields.

quenya: I roqueni turuner i kottor ar rehtaner i eldar.
english: The knights defeated the enemies and rescued the elves.

quenya: I taurë nánë varna ar rainë entúlë.
english: The forest was safe and peace returned (“to return” =entul-).
Some birds flew in the sky (or in the air).
Some wolves are hunting rabbits.
Some swans are floating in the lake.
Some chickens birthed (or laid) some eggs.
Some lions have eaten some sheep.
Some snakes rest in grass.

quenya: Lamneli farar ar lamneli uir fara.
english: Some animals hunt and some animals do not hunt.
Some fish eat seaweed (ëaruilë).
Some cats are chasing (roita-) some rats.
Some dogs watched the cows.
Some horses have run to the river.
Some bears fought the dragon.
A warrior’s captain.
The elf’s house.
A king’s warriors.
A warrior’s sword.
Fruits of trees.
Beginning of the day.
Towers of war.
Warriors’ swords.

quenya: I arano alkar or i aranwa alkar.
english: The king’s glory.
A house of joy (alassë).
We (and you) saw the king after dawn.

quenya: I yára elda quéta i nessa atanen sí.
english: The old elf is speaking to the young man now.
Sunset (is) the end of the day.
Stop!
I will love you forever.
He/she stood at the back of the house.

quenya: Kennen nís. I nís nánë halla.
english: I saw a woman. The woman was tall.
Altáriel [Galadriel] the Wise.
The arm of an orc.
Call the captain.
The last man.
The mast pushes a ship.
Stars shine in the heavens.
They will speak to the king.
He/she found an empty cave.
The elf [is] lonely in a crowd.
It is not [the] last number.
All [the] men came today.
We (and you) have enough bread.
Fill the cup, please.
Two lions watched the sheep.

quenya: I hesto quéta i ohtarin neldë.
english: The captain is speaking to the three warriors.
Twenty men stand at/in the gate.
Give one sword to me.
Both dwarves are sleeping in the tower.

quenya: Minya elda tarnë ar’ i ailin.
english: [The] first elf stood by the lake.
Even he/she will die from [by means of] a sword.
I want that even you will find peace.
Even they sleep at night.
Someone lived in this cave.

quenya: I orkor nakanter sé mal ú hyé.
english: The orcs slew him/her but not him/her [the other].

quenya: I nauko kennë i nér ar hye sérë i köassë.
english: The dwarf saw the man [male] and he [the man] rested in the house.
Even we (including you) are not immortal.
I will give even you (plural) some bread.
They discovered something yesterday.
I want that someone save even me.

quenya: I hesto quentë i ohtaren ar hye mennë i ostonna.
english: The captain spoke to the warrior and he [the warrior] went to the city.

quenya: I hesto quentë i ohtaren ar mennes i ostonna.
english: The captain spoke to the warrior and he [the captain] went to the city.
The hunting dog wants to chase rabbits.

quenya: Polil hlikë tuvë farna i tauressë.
english: You can sneak to discover prey in the forest.
To hide [or hiding] him/her saved the child.
Finish your hunting it tomorrow.
Hunting animals gives food to my people.
We [but not you] went to the forest for trapping.

quenya: I quessi aiwion (nár) márë pilin karien.
english: The feathers of birds are good for arrow making.
The bull’s horn is not long.
I can ride a horse every day.
A bird’s wing has some feathers.
I found her bow under the tree.
My finding it shows that she is in danger.
We [but not you] went to the centre of the forest.
The city sits among hills.

quenya: I orkor ménar minna i rotto.
english: The orcs are going into the cave.
I will see the captain at night.

quenya: I atani túler et i mindonillon.
english: The men came out of the towers.
The men slew orcs with [by means of] swords.

quenya: I elda mennë ó i naukor i mindonna.
english: The elf went with the dwarves to the tower.
The women are coming from there.

quenya: I nér tenkë i quenta tekilmen.
english: The man [male] wrote the story with a pen.

quenya: I aran apátië sundollo inganna i mindono.
english: The king has walked from the base to the top of the tower.
The house sits in the centre of a city.

quenya: Tárië i oronto tirë or i nando.
english: The height of the mountain watches above the valley.
Work caused me to become strong [= that I became strong].

quenya: Mára kardalya tulyauva lyen alassë (or more simply tulyuva).
english: Your good deed will bring you happiness.
Some dwarves broke the orcs’ swords.
Birds have knocked on trees in the forest.
Horses will pull the wagon swift[ly].

quenya: I sírë kúna pella i osto.
english: The river bends beyond the city.
Who do you love?
Did the elf smile?
Will you kiss me?
Where are the girls playing?
How can I please the king?
Are the men happy?
What is your answer?
Who is laughing?
Are they excited?
Where did the orcs come from?
Will you see the captain?
Do you want to watch the warriors?
Orcs terrified the forest’s halflings.

quenya: Soronyentë i orkor merner nahta te.
english: They were afraid that orcs wanted to slay them.

quenya: Orkor tevir periandi ar naukor ar eldar ar atani.
english: Orcs hate halflings and dwarves and elves and men.

quenya: Hrávë orkor marner rottossen nu i oronti.
english: Wild orcs dwelled in caves under the mountains.
Torment of halflings pleased the orcs.
The halflings lamented their fate.
Pain does not terrify dwarves.

quenya: Raiquë naukor faraner orkor i tauressë.
english: Angry dwarves hunted orcs in the forest.
The orcs growled in fear.
The rage of the dwarves was powerful.

quenya: I eldar náner nairië i mahtië quantanë i taurë.
english: The elves were sorrowful that fighting filled the forest.

quenya: Nier i eldaron sirinyer ve síri.
english: The tears of the elves flowed like rivers.
The treasure-giving king [is] rich.
Tradeable goods [are] precious.
The silver-having dwarf is not poor.
Orcs want to find takeable treasure.
The seized swords [are] lost.

quenya: I ohtari norner minna i lantaina ando.
english: The warriors ran into the fallen gate.

quenya: I antaula perian penë telpë sí.
english: The generous (prone to give) halfling lacks money now.

quenya: I kavaitë mahar harë i köassë.
english: The receptive (able to receive) merchant sits in the house.
All fighting warriors will die.

quenya: I kavinë annar rehtaner i nettion alassë.
english: The received gifts saved the girls’ happiness.

quenya: I eldar antaner i lepinë armar i heston.
english: The elves gave the taken goods to the captain.

quenya: I lepilë atani hander i mindonessë.
english: The taking men stayed (= sat) in the tower.
[It] snows.
Made the knife = the knife was made.

quenya: Mo namba taxi yá mo karasta köa.
english: One hammers nails when one builds a house.
Tools [are] shaped with a forge.
It rains.
One fashions a sword with craft.

quenya: I emma nánë takina i aldassë taxenen.
english: The picture was fastened on the wall with a nail.
The smith feels an urge to make a sword.

quenya: I nís sernë linta i laupë.
english: The woman sewed swift[ly] the shirt.

quenya: I periandi koller i korma andavë.
english: The halflings bore the ring long [for a long time].
The elves will depart from Middle-earth soon.

quenya: I mai karina vakko nánë hirina i rottossë.
english: The well made jacket was found in the cave.
The horse ran swift[ly].
The horse ran swiftly [= with swiftness].
The horse ran long.
The horse ran well.
The wind [is] cold beyond yesterday [= is colder than yesterday].
The knife [is] very sharp.
The cloak [is] very soft among clothing.
Mithril [is the] hardest [most hard] of metals.
The dwarf is very clever.

quenya: I atan finwa lá i nauko.
english: The man is more clever than the dwarf.
The elf is very clever among people.
The wizard [istar] is most clever of all.

quenya: Massë i asëa i asarta yuhtanë i naukon?
english: Where [is] the healing herb which the doctor used on [for] the dwarf?

quenya: I atani i túler i ostonna tárar i andossë.
english: The men who came to the city are standing in the gate.

quenya: I kirma yanen i hesto harnanë i elda nánë hirina nu i alda.
english: The knife with which the captain wounded the elf was found under the tree.

quenya: I asarta yen quentel nöa hasuva i nauko.
english: The doctor to whom you spoke yesterday will treat the dwarf.

quenya: Á hirë i atan ó ye i elda lendë.
english: Find the man with whom the elf travelled.

quenya: Késan i köan yassë i elda marë.
english: I am searching for (ces-[þ] + dative) the house in which the elf dwells.

quenya: Á tana nin i atan i samë i makil or á tana nin i atan sa samë i makil.
english: Show me the man who has the sword.

quenya: Istan i samil i hestova makil.
english: I know that you have the captain’s sword.
The woman lives there.

quenya: Ma meril nin anta si lyen?
english: Do you want for me to give this to you?
Open that door.
I will see him/her then [future].
The man [male] is standing on yonder hill.
I have these knives.
Will you give me that?

quenya: Merinyes sí or Merin sa sí.
english: I want it now.
I will clean myself.
He/she found himself/herself in a forest.
They dug a hole in the hill.
A sword [is] like a long knife.

They asked themselves where [whither] the captain went.
The girls stood in a circle.
It is the same man.

He/she can (is physically able to) fight.
He/she may (is free to) speak to the king.
He/she must (is compelled to) speak to the king.
